**Raymond Brown**  
Hiring Manager  
NSW Department of Communities and Justice  
Parramatta NSW, Australia  

Dear Mr. Brown,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Test Manager role with the NSW Department of Communities and Justice (DCJ). With over 19 years of quality engineering and test leadership experience—spanning enterprise system migrations, robust automation frameworks, and complex digital platforms, including previous delivery for Transport for NSW on the Opal Travel ticketing platform—I welcome the opportunity to establish proportionate, risk-based test governance that supports reliable public services.

Throughout my career, I have led testing activities for complex technology initiatives by establishing clear test strategies, risk controls, and automated quality gates. At Avant Mutual, I served as QA Lead directing the quality strategy for a large-scale migration from a legacy LAMP stack to a modern cloud-native .NET and React architecture. To mitigate architectural and data migration risks, I instituted end-to-end data integrity validation, managed environment readiness, and established strict entry and exit criteria. By driving daily defect triage, coverage analysis, and cross-functional release cycles, I ensured the platform met rigorous business specifications and quality requirements before go-live.

Managing challenging stakeholder expectations, external partners, and competing delivery priorities has been central to my leadership approach. At both Avant Mutual and Wpay (Woolworths Group), I routinely led alignment sessions between development leads, product managers, and business teams. When balancing delivery deadlines against defect resolution, I relied on evidence-based quality reporting and residual risk assessments to guide go-live decisions, stepping in as a dual Business Analyst and QA lead when necessary to clarify requirements and resolve scope ambiguities. Furthermore, by integrating automated regression suites into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and developing custom automation assets, I enabled teams to maintain high test coverage and release velocity without compromising quality gates.

I hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, ISTQB Foundation Certification, and Scrum Master (PSM/GSM) accreditation. I am eager to bring my background in test management, cross-functional stakeholder coordination, and quality engineering to the Department of Communities and Justice. 

Thank you for your time and consideration. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience can support DCJ’s technology initiatives.

Sincerely,

**Anoop Sinkaran**
